fry.definition:
n. English painter and art critic (1866-1934)
n. English dramatist noted for his comic verse dramas (born 1907)
v. be excessively hot
v. cook on a hot surface using fat
fry.translation:
n. 油炸食物, 鱼苗
v. 油炸, 煎

fry's theory.translation: [化] 弗莱氏理论; 交替极性说

fry-ups.translation: n. 煎火腿煎鸡蛋( fry-up的复数形式 )

frye.definition: n. Canadian literary critic interested in the use of myth and symbolism (1912-1991)
frye.translation: n. boot（高到小腿肚的）弗赖伊皮靴

fryer.definition: n. flesh of a medium-sized young chicken suitable for frying
fryer.translation: n. 做油煎食物的人, 可供油炸的食品, 油炸锅

fryers.definition:
plural of fryer
n. flesh of a medium-sized young chicken suitable for frying
fryers.translation: (fryer 的复数) n. 做油煎食物的人, 可供油炸的食品, 油炸锅

fryes.definition:
plural of frye
n. Canadian literary critic interested in the use of myth and symbolism (1912-1991)
fryes.translation: (frye 的复数) n. boot（高到小腿肚的）弗赖伊皮靴

frying.definition: n. cooking in fat or oil in a pan or griddle
frying.translation: v. 油炸, 油煎( fry的现在分词 ); 皮肤晒黑; 煎炸; 油发

frypan.definition: n a pan used for frying foods
frypan.translation: n. 煎锅, 长柄平锅
